name: Gavida

attributes.attribute: fostered Lugh until he could slay Balor
sometimes identified with the smith god Goibniu

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gavida was an Irish hero. He also bore the names Gaiblín, Gaibhleen, and Goibhleann. He was the brother of Cian. He was the uncle of the hero Lugh. Gavida fostered his nephew Lugh. He raised Lugh until the boy was ready to kill his monstrous grandfather. That grandfather was Balor of the Evil Eye. Some accounts say Gavida was the same as the smith god Goibniu.

okr.objective: Describe Gavida as the foster father of Lugh and kinsman of the smith gods.
key_results: Gavida was the brother of Cian and uncle of Lugh.
He fostered Lugh until the hero could face Balor.
Some texts identify Gavida with the smith god Goibniu.
